decision: depcruise gets its own tsconfig per app with baseUrl + paths and a files list

decision: browser B never showed shapes drawn in A; root cause: the Y map stored Excalidraw's live element objects, which Excalidraw mutates in place, so later versions looked already synced and only the zero-size v2 snapshot was ever sent
why: probe client showed every A-drawn element at version 2 with width 0
result: live sync A->B and B->A verified in two tabs

decision: remote state is applied only after Excalidraw finishes its own scene init (first onChange with isLoading false), then one full reconcile; media waits on the same signal
why: on client-side navigation the board loaded empty although the doc had all elements; Excalidraw's init replaced the scene
result: SPA nav + hidden-tab reload render full scene and S3 images

decision: two-tab browser smoke: sign up, create board, draw both ways, MCP key from the UI, MCP add_elements appears live, image drop uploads to S3 and appears live in the other tab

decision: typecheck gate runs tsc --noEmit per package instead of turbo check-types

decision: all 5 gates proven: every RED proof fails the gate on its own rule, every GREEN passes
why: a gate that cannot fail proves nothing
evidence: bunx redproof prove output in session

decision: built the Dokploy images locally (web, server, migrate) from a clean repo build without .env files
why: Dokploy clones the repo, so builds must not depend on gitignored env files
evidence: docker compose -f docker-compose.dokploy.yml build: 3 images Built

decision: stopped the local Dokploy stack run: the host disk hit 100% (1.2G free) and the Docker daemon stopped answering
why: postgres failed to start, docker ps/info time out; deleting images or restarting Docker needs the user

decision: independent review (security-reviewer agent, Fable) found cross-site websocket hijacking and CSRF via SameSite=None cookies, unsandboxed SVG serving, 128 MiB pre-validation buffering, unbounded MCP strings, unguarded ws frame parsing
why: second model on the trust boundaries before handing back
result: 6 fixed, 1 accepted (client-declared MIME, mitigated by sandbox+nosniff)

decision: one onRequest origin guard: requests with a foreign Origin are rejected (403) for non-GET methods and websocket upgrades; no-Origin clients (MCP, SSR) pass
why: SameSite=None is required because web and API are on different sites; CORS does not stop form posts or WS upgrades
evidence: apps/server/src/shared/presentation/plugins/originGuard.ts, curl: evil POST 403, evil WS 403, MCP no key 401

decision: server body limit 11 MiB, file responses get CSP sandbox + nosniff, MCP text/colour length caps, ws receive wrapped
why: review findings 3,4,7,8
evidence: curl 12MB upload -> 413; headers not re-checked live because Postgres was down with Docker

decision: file download streams bytes through the API instead of a 302 to a presigned S3 URL
why: the browser fetches with credentials and a cross-origin redirect to S3 fails on bucket CORS; streaming keeps one origin
result: deviation from plan, sandboxed per review

decision: .mcp.json marked skip-worktree locally so git add -A cannot stage the user's Dokploy key
why: the file is tracked (scaffold) so .git/info/exclude would not help

decision: new run segment: v2 features, Redis, Dokploy deploy

decision: Dokploy env-tab interpolation reached only POSTGRES_PASSWORD in compose mode, so secrets moved to a mounted env file, then the whole stack moved to split services

decision: dropped pgrust (malisper/pgrust v0.4-beta) for postgres:18-alpine

decision: split Dokploy into narbel-web, narbel-api, narbel-store (RustFS app), narbel-db (native Postgres), narbel-cache (native Redis), provisioned by scripts/dokploy-provision.ts

decision: API applies Drizzle migrations at boot (MIGRATIONS_DIR set in image); migrate image stage and compose migrate service removed

decision: session cookie is SameSite=Lax without Secure on http, None+Secure on https

result: sign-up sets cookie on deployed web
